We welcome motivated researchers and students who are passionate about understanding how the brain shapes mental health. We value curiosity, rigour, and collaborative work.

---

## Open Positions {.section-heading}

There are no funded PhD or postdoc positions currently available. However, we are always interested in hearing from strong candidates. If you are considering applying for external fellowship funding and your research interests overlap with ours, please get in touch; see [PhD Opportunities](#phd) and [Postdoctoral Opportunities](#postdoc) below.

---

## MSc Thesis Projects {.section-heading}

We regularly supervise MSc thesis students. Currently this is open to students from Maastricht University only.


**How to apply:** Send an email with: (1) brief motivation (half page), (2) your
CV, and (3) your transcript. Include "MSc Thesis Inquiry" in the subject line.

[<i class="bi bi-envelope-fill"></i> Email NeuroMH Lab](mailto:franc.donkers@maastrichtuniversity.nl?subject=MSc%20Thesis%20Inquiry){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}

**Timeline:** Applications reviewed on a rolling basis. 

---


## PhD Opportunities {#phd .section-heading}

We can host **PhD candidates who bring their own funding**, for example a national scholarship or personal grant, provided the project aligns with the lab's research themes.

Relevant funding routes include:

- National scholarship schemes from the applicant's home country (for example CSC, Fulbright, DAAD, and similar national programmes)
- MSCA Doctoral Networks (EU): funded PhD positions hosted by the lab or a consortium, advertised when available

If one of these applies to you, get in touch with a CV and a brief research statement.

---

## Postdoctoral Opportunities {#postdoc .section-heading}

We do not currently have funded postdoctoral openings, but we welcome inquiries from researchers interested in applying for **fellowship funding** together with the lab. Relevant schemes include:

- NWO Veni (Netherlands)
- Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowship (EU)

If your research interests match ours and you are interested in applying for one of these, please get in touch with a CV and a brief research statement.
